name: po-pilot-mcp
description: Post-Stocky Shopify replenishment, Open-to-Buy & landed-cost MOQ Purchase Orders, POS Transfer CSVs, Stocky CSV recovery, and 3-way invoice match with QuickBooks/Xero Bill CSVs.

calculate_replenishment_plan.description: Computes margin-weighted ABC classes, stockout-adjusted daily velocity, demand + lead-time variability safety stock, reorder points, and carton-rounded order recommendations.

build_supplier_purchase_orders.description: Groups SKUs by vendor, enforces carton multiples + MOQ/USD thresholds, computes US tariff + freight landed costs and Open-to-Buy rationing, and outputs Shopify PO + POS Transfer CSVs.

reconcile_po_three_way_match.description: Cross-checks PO vs warehouse receiving vs supplier invoice to catch price creep, short-shipments, and unapproved fees, outputting a Debit Memo + QuickBooks/Xero Bill CSVs.

migrate_stocky_csv_snapshot.description: Reconstructs un-exportable supplier directory, real lead times, carton multiples, and SKU cost history from Stocky Purchase Order CSV exports.
